descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Science Soldier character from the Pharaoh's Servant set. It is a 1st Edition Common card with the card number PSV-097. The card type is Normal and it has a card number of PSV-097. The Defense/Toughness of the card is 800 and it has an Attack/Power of 800. The card is perfect for collectors and players of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game.
